description.en: Plays facility and area BGM chosen by weighted random from Assets/sounds/musics and state/musics/place, with a playlist per facility type (inn, guild, shops...) and per area size (town, village, city, dungeon). Weights live in state/musics/place/playlist.json
description.ja: 宿屋・ギルド・店などの施設の種類ごと、町・村・都市・ダンジョンの土地の種類ごとに、Assets/sounds/musics と state/musics/place にある曲から重みで BGM を選んで鳴らす。重みは state/musics/place/playlist.json で指定する

note.ja: 施設の種類と土地の種類ごとに、鳴らす曲と重みを決める画面。state/musics/place/playlist.json に保存する
note.en: Pick tracks and weights per facility type and per area size; saves state/musics/place/playlist.json

label.en: Weight given when a track is put in use

note.ja: 設定画面で曲を「使う」に入れたときの初期値。置いただけの曲は一覧に出るだけで、入れるまで鳴らない
note.en: Initial weight when a track is put in use from the settings screen. Tracks merely placed in the folder are listed and never play until chosen

label.ja: 前回と同じ曲を続けて選ばない
label.en: Do not pick the same track twice in a row

note.ja: 同じ種類の場所で候補が2曲以上あるときだけ効く。覚えている場所（下の2つ）には効かない
note.en: Only when two or more tracks are eligible for the same kind of place. Does not apply to remembered places

label.ja: 土地の曲は一度決めたら覚える
label.en: Remember the track chosen for each area

note.ja: 入。土地ごとに最初に選んだ曲を state/musics/place/worlds/<世界>.json に覚え、次からも同じ曲を鳴らす（素のゲームと同じく土地に曲が付く）。切ると入るたびに選び直す
note.en: On: the first track chosen for an area is remembered in state/musics/place/worlds/<world>.json and played again next time (an area keeps its music, as in the game). Off: re-rolled on every visit

label.ja: 施設の曲は一度決めたら覚える
label.en: Remember the track chosen for each facility

note.ja: 切。入れると施設ごとに最初に選んだ曲を覚え、その宿・その店ではいつも同じ曲が鳴る
note.en: Off. On: the first track chosen for a facility is remembered, so that inn or shop always plays the same track
